CustomField.description: Per-section override of the Form Template's Data Conversion Tags. NOT consumed by the package's conversion engine; stamped onto the submission's Internal_Data_Conversion_Tag_s__c (by the sample Global Form Submission Utility flow in force-app-demo, or your own automation) for use in your own record-triggered Flow entry conditions. The section value takes precedence; the sample flow falls back to the template's tags when this is blank.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optionally tag just this section's data, overriding the template-level Data Conversion Tags. These get stamped onto the submission for use in your own downstream record-triggered Flows; leave blank to inherit the template's tags.
CustomField.label: Data Conversion Tag(s)
